SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BUYER, INV_NO FROM IF_UCUBE_IP_SEND WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.ATTR_01 AS PLANT, A.INV_NO AS LEGACY_IV_NO, A.ATTR_02 AS LEGACY_PR_NO, A.PARCEL_COM_CODE, A.PARCEL_INV_NO, C.LEGACY_PO_NO, C.LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM IF_UCUBE_IP_SEND A , ICOMIVDT B , ICOMPODT C WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$' AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N' AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.INV_NO = A.INV_NO AND C.BUYER = B.BUYER AND C.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND C.PO_SEQ = C.PO_SEQ
UPDATE IF_UCUBE_IP_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE IF_UCUBE_IP_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
